column4: *(The bhāṣya of this Ṛk is given here in outline only, because the Sanskrit of the page is very compact and runs through the legend and the number-reckoning; I have transcribed the main body and have marked the doubtful parts [?].)*
*(The bhāṣya on this page is dense and its second half is compressed; I give the Sanskrit as read, with the doubtful stretches marked [?], and the sense below.)*
*(Pada as printed: "rāye" at the third-line end is read "रायः" by the Pada; the print has "रायः" and the Saṃhitā "रायेऽधि" with avagraha mark — as read, [?].)*

*(Kannada script; the bhāṣya's grammatical tail is in small, compressed type; the sūtra wording and number after "ādṛgamahanajanaḥ" and the clause on* nittvād ādyudāttatvam *are read with doubt [?]; one clause after* bhayante *is omitted as illegible.)*
*(Kannada script; the grammatical tail is in compressed type; sūtra wording as read, the Uṇādi numeral and some clauses doubtful [?].)*
*(The Saṃhitā and Pada as printed carry slight differences in the verb ending [*nunudra/nunudre*] and in the second-line vowel-lengthening; as printed, not corrected [?].)*
*(Kannada script; "no [yūyaṃ?]" and the last clause "etadīyastotrakāritam" are doubtful [?].)*
*(Kannada script; the tail is compressed; "kramarṇi", "vyatyastimāsthām" and the Pāṇini numeral are read with doubt [?]; the Nirukta and Aitareya numerals are small and uncertain [?].)*
*(application note: "aptoryāme" as printed; the sūtra and its numeral are cramped and read with doubt [?].)*
*(Transcription note: the running quotation of the Anukramaṇī, with its reading "saha" and the spelling "tryadhikā / pañcamyādi", is as printed and is not corrected [?].)*
*(The sūtra as printed reads "…vāmānyaṃ divo mātariśvā jabhāra"; the words run together in the print and are given here as read [?].)*

*(The print's* asi ca no 'smān *is read as printed, where the sense requires* kṛdhi *or the like — it is presumably a misprint for* asmān *alone; also the opening clause* asi ca nosmān *[?]. The sūtras are named without numbers in this tail; none supplied.)*
